kevin: Heads-up — after we enabled the new client prefetch in the sampleapp onboarding flow I started seeing a big spike in 429s and latency. Cursor seems to get replayed and we end up with duplicate page requests. Anyone seen this?

maria: Saw a similar blip in staging this morning. Repro with ~40 concurrent sim users. Did you change the prefetch window or concurrency?

kevin: I toggled `prefetch.window = 3` and `client.maxConcurrency = 8` to try to improve perceived latency. Logs look like: many requests for the same cursor id, server returns 400 for invalid cursor then client retries -> hits rate limiter and gets 429.

kevin: ```
2024-05-18T12:01:02Z GET /v1/pages?cursor=abc123 200 next_cursor=def456
2024-05-18T12:01:03Z GET /v1/pages?cursor=def456 400 invalid_cursor
2024-05-18T12:01:03Z client retry -> GET /v1/pages?cursor=def456 429 rate_limited
```

zoe: Can you paste the SDK config you're using? We had a parity bug earlier where Go SDK didn't add jitter so retries lined up and amplified the surge.

kevin: ```js
// sampleapp client config
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  maxConcurrency: 8,
  prefetch: { window: 3 },
  retry: { attempts: 3, backoffMs: 200 }
});
```

aj: Two quick thoughts: 1) The client retry loop must inspect 4xx vs 5xx. If server returns 400 (invalid cursor) the client should not retry that page — it's a client-side state error. 2) Prefetch can enqueue the same cursor multiple times if next-page confirmation is racy. Combined those explain dup requests.

maria: Exactly. Sampleapp's paginator enqueues next page immediately when prefetch window triggers instead of waiting for a confirmation that the previous page advanced. With aggressive retry + no jitter we get thundering retries.

kevin: I'll open a PR to add a guard: if we get 400/422 mark the cursor as dead and drop pending prefetches for that session. Also will cap prefetch concurrency to 2 for onboarding flow.

zoe: + add randomized jitter to retry and exponential backoff (e.g., base 100ms * 2^n with jitter). Also consider switching token-bucket smoothing from per-second to a leaky window (50/min) for bursty onboarding traffic.

kevin: Good call. Also adding a small client-side throttle that folds duplicate pending cursor ids — dedupe before enqueue.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded for branch fix/prefetch-guard to staging (build 4521) :white_check_mark:

aj: Nice. Also we should update SDK parity docs noting the default retry semantics (what 4xx means, what 5xx means) and include a short sample in sampleapp showing safe prefetch config.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll add a tiny test harness in sampleapp that runs a scripted onboarding surge so we can catch regressions in CI.

kevin: Thanks all, assigning follow-ups: kevin -> PR for guard + dedupe; zoe -> jitter + backoff helper; maria -> CI harness + docs edit. Will report back after staging smoke.
